name: Device Compromise Lifecycle — RPZ Block + Threat-Protect DROP Same IP
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "Threat"
| filter infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log contains "RPZ-QNAME" or infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log contains "rpz QNAME"
| alter src_ip = arrayindex(regextract(infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log, "src=(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0)
| filter src_ip != null
| bin _time span = 60m
| comp count() as rpz_blocks by src_ip, _time
| filter rpz_blocks >= 1
| join (
    datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
    | filter xdm.event.type = "Threat"
    | filter _raw_log contains "threat-protect-log"
    | alter src_ip = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "src=(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0)
    | filter src_ip != null
    | comp count() as tp_drops by src_ip
    | filter tp_drops >= 1
  ) as tp src_ip = tp.src_ip
| fields src_ip
description: Same internal IP triggered both RPZ DNS block AND BloxOne Threat-Protect drop.
alert_name: Device Compromise Lifecycle — RPZ Block + Threat-Protect DROP Same IP
